context: Sho-young describes a vivid dream he had to Sakura at breakfast.
purpose: Child sharing imagination with adult mentor.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: さくらさん、不思議な夢見た!
lines.en: Sakura, I had the strangest dream!
lines.style: Bright, breathless opening. Quick and eager — a 6-year-old bursting to share. Warm and open-hearted. Natural child energy without affectation.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.style: Genuinely curious, inviting him in. Soft and unhurried. The tone of someone who actually wants to hear this — not indulging, but present.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.en: I was flying through the sky!
lines.style: Wonder-struck and breathless. The 'flying' lands with genuine awe — not performed, real. Light and almost floating in the delivery, matching the dream itself.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.style: Tender and sincere. Soft landing on each word. She's not just being kind — she's genuinely moved by his joy. Quiet warmth, like tucking something precious away.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.en: I want to have it again.
lines.style: Hopeful and wistful. A small child's longing, not demanding. Soft trailing into the thought, like he's half-talking to himself. Genuine wish, not performance.
